statement: n = 0 → ∃ x : YuiEucl n, E = {x} ∧ Isometry (YuiSnoc x) ∧ YuiCylinder E = (YuiSnoc x) '' YuiI ∧ dimH E = 0
proof:
intro hn
subst n
obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h_H002
have hE : E = {x} := by
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · intro _; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · rintro rfl; exact hx
refine ⟨x, hE, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· apply Isometry.of_dist_eq
  intro t u
  rw [(h_T003 0).2.2.1 x x t u]
  simp [Real.dist_eq, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
· ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨YuiLast z, hz.2, ?_⟩
    have hh : YuiHead z = x := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simpa only [hh] using (h_T003 0).2.1 z
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(h_T003 0).1 x t |>.1 ▸ hx, (h_T003 0).1 x t |>.2 ▸ ht⟩
· have h0 : dimH E ≤ 0 := by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using h_T005.1.2.1
  exact le_antisymm h0 zero_le

            ∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : ↑A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A) →

            (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧

                LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
